newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens confirms police search at unit.
newsitem.headline: Siemens confirms police search at unit.

text.p: German electronics giant Siemens AG confirmed at the weekend that police had searched offices of its Siemens-Nixdorf unit removing certain documents.
Siemens spokesman Thomas Weber told Reuters the search had taken place, confirming an article in this week's edition of the newsmagazine Der Spiegel.
In an advance copy of the article, Spiegel said police had combed through six separate offices at the group's Siemens-Nixdorf computer unit as part of an investigation into document falsification.
Spiegel said officials raided the offices and carted off papers after suspecting managers may have back-dated termination contracts for a number of years.
The backdating of contracts increased unemployment insurance payments by a sum of at least 10 million marks, the magazine reported.
